sentences.text:
THIS WP IS FILED UNDER ARTICLES 226 AND 227 OF THE  CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO DIRECTING THE  RESPONDENT TO CONSIDER THE CALCULATION MEMO  REPRESENTATION DATED 16-01-2015 GIVEN BY THE PETITIONERS  TO THE RESPONDENT AND TO PAY THE BALANCE COMPENSATION OF  RS. 98,92,949/-VIDE ANNEXURE-E.
 -2-  NC: 2024:KHC-D:917  WP No. 105962 of 2015  THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN B GROUP, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The Deputy Commissioner, Ballari in excise of the power under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, determined the compensation payable to the land bearing Sy. No.323 measuring 21 acres 68 cents situated at Hosapete at Rs.65,000/- per acre with all statutory benefits.

The compensation amount having not been disbursed in light of the award passed by the Deputy Commissioner,
prompted the petitioner to approach this Court in W.P. No.63093/2010.
This Court vide order dated 15.01.2013 directed the respondent - SLAO to disburse the amount in accordance with law if not already disbursed.
2. In the light of the order passed by this Court, the petitioner submitted a representation alongwith the memo of calculation to pay the balance sum of Rs.1,20,66,500/-.
The respondent No.1 disbursed an amount of Rs.55,21,632/-.
The petitioner submitted a representation stating that the compensation amount disbursed is less than the amount of compensation awarded by the Deputy Commissioner.
The NC: 2024:KHC-D:917 representation having not been considered, the petitioner approached this Court in W.P. No.85457/2013.

This Court vide order dated 28.07.2014 directed the respondent No.1 to consider the memo of calculation filed by the petitioner and pay the compensation amount, if any due.
3.
In light of the order passed by this Court in W.P. No.85457/2013, the respondent No.1 released an amount of Rs.21,73,551/- on 17.11.2014.
Petitioners' grievance is that the total amount of compensation disbursed in favour of the petitioners is not in conformity with the award passed by the Deputy Commissioner concerned.
Therefore, he submitted a representation afresh to release the balance compensation amount.
4. Learned AGA submitted that the representation submitted by the petitioners will be considered in accordance with law, if reasonable time is granted.
